title: chair.chrismoore-reverb~
description: `chair.chrismoore-reverb~` is a Pd Vanilla implementation of the Chris Moore reverb, intended to add reverberation to an audio signal. It provides controls for input and feedback low-pass/high-pass filtering, feedback gain, and dry/wet mix; these parameters can also be supplied as arguments, with defaults of 13000 8 13000 8 2.4 0.5.
